newsitem.title: USA: McKesson's Pulido to step up to CEO post.
newsitem.headline: McKesson's Pulido to step up to CEO post.

text.p: McKesson Corp on Tuesday named Mark Pulido, currently president and chief operating officer, as its new chief executive officer, replacing Alan Seelenfreund.
Pulido, 44, will take the company's reins on April 1, at the start of McKesson's new fiscal year. He joined the company in May 1996.
Sellenfreund, 60, will retain his position as chairman of the health care company's board of directors. He has been chairman and chief executive officer since November 1989.
"Mark Pulido is a dynamic executive fully committed to our vision with the qualities to guide our company into the next century," Sellenfreund said in a statement.

"I have looked forward to the day when I could confidently turn over the direction of McKesson to a successor who not only shares my strategic goals, but also demonstrates the operational expertise to move the company forward," he added.

Pulido holds 20 years of experience in the health care industry including previous management positions at McKesson. Before rejoining the company last May, he was president and chief executive officer of Novartis AG unit Sandoz Pharmaceuticals Corp.
